Hi to everybody, 

I'm completly new to the Holography community and to this forum too...

I have ""accidentally"" discovered the following kickstarter project

[https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/15 ... escription](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1508643250/vvd-an-affordable-real-3d-volumetric-display/description)

May I ask you information about these kinds of devices.

Actually I'm not completly new to the laser field as i have build a xy laser projector from a 5.1 PC soundcard but I have just discovered the third dimension now ...

I would be very happy to gather as much technical information as possible in the objective of trying to build an homemade version of such a great device.

Hope you will understand 

1° my bad english 

2° my numerous requests 

Very happy to have discover such a nice forum ! 

Have a great day 

Skappy

posts.content_md:
I suspect that many amateur holographers here make display holograms for the fun and the challenge.

That black box doesn't add anything to that pursuit.

I can see that it may have some use in the engineering environment, prototyping, those sorts of applications.

Maybe it could be used to display the results of an MRI scan, if the black box could produce an image that was significantly bigger.

Steven.
